name: SD.cpp Studio style templates
description: Style templates for generation. Each style has just two fields: prompt and negative_prompt. In prompt, use the {prompt} placeholder where your own prompt should go; if you omit it, the template is simply prepended to your prompt. The negative_prompt is appended to your negative prompt. Edit this file to add, change, or remove styles.
